structs.name: Umbra__ImpShadowCuller
structs.size_evidence: not proven. Replay lower bound 45904: the last fixed member m_cascades[7] ends at 34512 + 8*1424 = 45904 (ctor loop of 8, step 1424; buildVisibleSet 0x141f8d230 computes 1424LL*i + 34512), and the variable bit array starts at 45904. Replay upper bound 53248: Umbra::ShadowCullerExt elements of s_umbraShadowCullersPool are 53248 bytes (dynamic_initializer_for_s_umbraShadowCullersPool 0x140355f50: loop of 20, step 6656 QWORDs = 53248 bytes; the pool global is __int64[133120] = 20 * 53248). The culler sits at element start (Umbra::ShadowCullerExt::ShadowCullerExt 0x141f8c3b0 calls the ctor at (this+15)&~15). Candidate 45920 (game-test and IDA) is consistent with C sizeof of a trailing unsigned int[1] (45908) rounded to 16, but no Replay access proves the trailing 12 bytes. Builder 48032 is wrong: it assumed a 1400-byte Transformer; Replay proves 1424.

Owner-side ideas, not applied: the global s_umbraShadowCullersPool (0x1502bf0b0, currently __int64[133120]) is an array of 20 ShadowCullerExt elements at 53248-byte stride (dynamic_initializer_for_s_umbraShadowCullersPool loop of 20, R_Umbra_QueryStaticVisibilityCmd index 6656*(v6-12) QWORDs); retyping it would need the ShadowCullerExt struct, which was not in this pass.
